app[content][about]:
[img]{STEAM_APP_IMAGE}/extras/refluff_clip3_tools[/img]
[b]Ten tools, one right order.[/b] Chip the dried crust with the scraper, foam the grime, scrub it in with the rotary brush, then plow the slurry off the rug with the squeegee.

[img]{STEAM_APP_IMAGE}/extras/hdr_reveal[/img]
[img]{STEAM_APP_IMAGE}/extras/refluff_clip1_reveal[/img]
The wet vacuum pulls the murky slurry out of the pile and the pattern comes back, one satisfying pass at a time.

[img]{STEAM_APP_IMAGE}/extras/hdr_water[/img]
[img]{STEAM_APP_IMAGE}/extras/refluff_clip2_water[/img]
Water soaks in and wicks through the pile, dry dust turns to mud the moment it gets wet, and foam heaps up and slowly settles. Nothing is a mask being erased: a fluid simulation runs under every fibre.

[img]{STEAM_APP_IMAGE}/extras/hdr_rugs[/img]
[img]{STEAM_APP_IMAGE}/extras/refluff_clip4_rugs[/img]
Hand the clean rug over and the next one flies in. Every job rolls its own mix of dust, grime, crust and spills over a real museum carpet.

[img]{STEAM_APP_IMAGE}/extras/hdr_paid[/img]
[img]{STEAM_APP_IMAGE}/extras/refluff_clip5_paid[/img]
The pay slip prints line by line: speed bonus, spotless, bone dry, combo. Spend it on POWER and AREA upgrades for any tool, or on inspection lamps that show the moisture and dirt your eyes miss.

[h2]Headphones on[/h2]
Every machine is a recording of a real one: motors spool up and wind down, the vacuum tube rattles the moment it swallows a crumb, water hisses, foam fizzes, bristles drag.

[list]
[*]A real-time fluid simulation of water, foam, mud and dried crust
[*]10 tools: eight for the carpet, plus a detergent sprayer and a mop for the floor
[*]No enemies, no fail state, no timer running out: the speed bonus only ever adds
[*]Single player, mouse and keyboard, interface in 31 languages
[*]Requires a DirectX 12 graphics card
[/list]
app[content][short_description]: Refluff is a carpet cleaning ASMR sim built on a real fluid simulation. Scrape off dried crust, soak the pile, foam it, brush it, squeegee the slurry out and dry the fibers until the rug is spotless. Hand it over, get paid, upgrade your kit, take the next one.
app[content][sysreqs][windows][min][grap: DirectX 12 graphics card with compute shader support, 4 GB VRAM (NVIDIA GeForce GTX 1060 6 GB / AMD Radeon RX 580 8 GB)
app[content][sysreqs][windows][min][soun: Any DirectX compatible sound device. Headphones recommended.
app[content][sysreqs][windows][rec][grap: NVIDIA GeForce RTX 3060 / AMD Radeon RX 6600 XT or better
app[content][sysreqs][windows][rec][soun: Any DirectX compatible sound device. Headphones strongly recommended.
app[assets][extra][4][alt_text]: A hose sprays a dry, dusty rug; the water spreads and turns the dust into dark mud, then a pink foam mound is sprayed on and slowly settles.
app[assets][extra][5][alt_text]: A spotless rug lifts off in a burst of sparkles and flies away, then a new dirty rug flies in and lands on the tiles.
app[assets][extra][6][alt_text]: A wet vacuum nozzle glides across a rug covered in murky brown slurry, and the bright red and cream pattern appears behind it.
app[assets][extra][7][alt_text]: A scraper breaks dried mud crust on a red rug and chunks fly onto the tiles, then pink foam is sprayed on, a rotary brush scrubs it in and a squeegee pushes the slurry off the rug.
app[assets][extra][8][alt_text]: After a clean rug is handed over, the pay slip prints line by line with a combo stamp and a $120 total, then the upgrade shop opens and two upgrades are bought.
